title: Reindexing a Boolean function
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers and let $e:[m]\simeq[n]$ be a bijection. Given a function $f$ from the $m$-dimensional Boolean cube to the sign group, define its reindexing on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube by assigning to each input $x$ the value of $f$ at the input whose $i$th coordinate is $x(e(i))$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued function on the $m$-dimensional Boolean cube
